CH 02 · Playable scene

The Drive

Two main characters, Ian and Saoirse, talk in the car after Ian picks her up on the road following her accident. They have not seen each other in ten years. The atmosphere in the car is awkward and tense. You are in control of the conversation. Your choices set flags that change later lines and gate later options. Four endings in all. Click to advance; click again to skip the type-on.

Outcome

endings found 0 / 0

Design note: This scene runs on the game's dialogue system: persistent flags, gated choices, escalating reactions, and a hidden ending that rewards restraint. Choices made in the opening beats change what Ian and Saoirse say. Narration beats pace the scene between lines, the way they would in the full game, where what you say in the car follows you for the rest of the investigation.

This scene also exists as a linear screenplay — the canonical cut, as it happens in the novel, with margin notes on where the two versions diverge.
